summary: Stateless __thiscall entry point that first presents vehicle statistics estimation using a global session/name buffer, then performs a virtual dispatch at vtable offset 0xA4 on the incoming this pointer and returns that call's result. The ABI label (Sub_Call_Virtual_Dispatch) and the vtable-indirect call are the only structural signals; both the receiver object and the dispatched method are unidentified.

operations.description: Call VehicleStatsEstimationDisplay with the address of the global byte_7C56C0 buffer as its session context argument.
Load the vtable pointer stored at this+0x0.
Dispatch a __thiscall virtual method through the vtable entry at offset 0xA4, invoking it with this as the receiver.
Return the integer result produced by the virtual call at vtable+0xA4.
